Policy

Returns & Refund Policy

We want you to love your AT Signature fragrance. If something is not right, this page explains how returns, exchanges and refunds work.

Return eligibility

You can request a return within 7 days of delivery. The item must be unopened, sealed and in its original packaging. Fragrances that have been sprayed or used cannot be returned for hygiene reasons.

Damaged or incorrect items

If your order arrives damaged, leaking, or is not what you ordered, contact us within 48 hours of delivery through Instagram or Facebook. Send your order details and clear photos of the item and packaging. We will arrange a replacement or a refund at no cost to you.

Refunds

Once your return has been received and checked, we will confirm the refund by message. Approved refunds are processed within 7 working days to the original payment method. Delivery charges are non-refundable unless the error was ours.

Exchanges

You may exchange for another AT Signature fragrance, subject to availability. If the new item costs more, you pay the difference. If it costs less, we refund the difference.

Non-returnable items

Discovery Sets, opened bundles and items sold at a clearance price are final sale, unless they arrive damaged or incorrect.

How to start a return

Message us on Instagram or Facebook with your order number, the product name and the reason for the return. We will reply with the next steps.

Policy

Privacy Policy

This page explains what information AT Signature collects when you shop with us and how we use it. We only collect what we need to take and deliver your order.

What we collect

When you place an order or contact us, we may collect your name, phone number, delivery address, the products you ordered and any messages you send us through Instagram or Facebook.

How we use it

We use these details to confirm, pack and deliver your order, to handle returns and refunds, and to answer your questions. We may also contact you about your order.

Who we share it with

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with the delivery partners and payment providers needed to complete your order.

Your choices

You can ask us to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by messaging us on Instagram or Facebook. We will respond within a reasonable time.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the latest change will be shown on this page.
